description_en: Retrieves the live streaming URL of an IPC device
description_zh: 调用该接口获取IPC设备的直播开播地址
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual query-live-streaming --scheme rtmp --iot-instance-id iot-cn-n6w1y590000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name camera1 --enable-stun true --stream-type 0 --cache-duration 0 --iot-id C47T6xwp6ms4bNlkHRWCg40000 --should-encrypt true --url-valid-duration 60 --play-un-limited false --encrypt-type 1 --force-iframe false --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryLiveStreaming

parameters.description_en:

- **hls**: HLS protocol.
- **flv**: HTTP-FLV protocol.

parameters.description_en:
The device ID of the IPC device. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device. You can call [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) to query the device ID.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. **IotId** is a globally unique identifier of the device and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** on a one-to-one basis. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>
parameters.description_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台[QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~)查询。

><notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。**IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>
